title: Hot Sulphur Springs–Parshall Fire Protection District Ballot Question 6A
scopeNote: Hot Sulphur Springs–Parshall Fire Protection District only. No exact district division found locally. The town, ParshallCDP,GrandCounty and GrandFireProtectionDistrict1 cannot substitute; official exact district territory and government match required.
questionText: Shall Hot Sulphur Springs - Parshall Fire Protection District waive the 5.25% property tax limit for all future property tax years?

measureRecord.whatItDoes: Waive the district’s 5.25% property-tax growth limit for all future property-tax years. The question states no new tax rate or specific start year.
measureRecord.yesMeans: Approve the district’s property-tax growth-limit waiver.
measureRecord.noMeans: Do not approve this property-tax growth-limit waiver.
